verses.pali: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami …pe… ekamantaṁ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: Then a mendicant went up to the Buddha … and asked him,
“Sir, they speak of this thing called the ‘spiritual path’.

verses.pali: Katamaṁ nu kho, bhante, brahmacariyaṁ, katamaṁ brahmacariyapariyosānan”ti?
verses.english: What is the spiritual path? And what is the culmination of the spiritual path?”

verses.pali: “Ayameva kho, bhikkhu, ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo brahmacariyaṁ, seyyathidaṁ—
verses.english: “Mendicant, the spiritual path is simply this noble eightfold path, that is:
right view, right purpose, right speech, right action, right livelihood, right effort, right mindfulness, and right immersion.

verses.pali: Yo kho, bhikkhu, rāgakkhayo dosakkhayo mohakkhayo—
verses.english: The ending of greed, hate, and delusion.
This is the culmination of the spiritual path.”
